features.text: Add on-demand channel matching for the M3U TV app
Add AED profile using ESPN API for automated EPG generation

Store provider last_modified in the app timezone
Keep conversation switches from mixing streams or losing approvals (#1797, #1798)
Stop overlapping metadata fetches deleting live episodes
Select metadata batches by id cursor, not offset
Detect quality from width as well as height
Report manifest transport failures as connection failures
Reject expired Playlist Auths on M3U and HDHR output
Repoint merged groups and categories when duplicating
Scope the channels heading to the selected playlist and type
Keep the valid channel name 0 in fallback matching
Rate limiting applying universally instead of per route
Count each library file once, as measured on disk, in the disk quota
Give every recording its own output file
Cache warming and response timeout fixes
Refresh expired provider covers on sync
